name: CA-47
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 6 points on the PVI
Incumbent Dave Min holds a huge financial advantage ($1.9M vs $129K cash)
Prediction markets price Min at 98% to win
No public general-election polling in the race
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Min: a D+6 seat, incumbency, and a lopsided money edge over Jenny Le Roux, with markets pricing the race at 98% Democratic. With no polls to contradict that picture, the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A late surge in Republican outside spending or an unexpected polling miss in this Orange County seat could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Dave Min, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking a second term in this Orange County district that leans Democratic by about six points. He advanced to the general election and has raised roughly $3.4 million, leaving nearly $1.9 million on hand. Republican Jenny Le Roux has raised under $400,000 with about $129,000 available, and outside spending on either side has been minimal.

Prediction markets on both Kalshi and Polymarket give Min about a 98 percent chance of winning. With no public general-election polls available, the outlook rests on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the large fundraising gap, all of which favor Min decisively.
